gui.essentialcraft5.crafter.frame_slot.d.en: With a frame, each slot only takes what the pattern needs
gui.essentialcraft5.crafter.frame_slot.d.zh: 装上框架，每格只收样板要的原料

gui.essentialcraft5.crafting_frame.mode..en: Each slot takes anything the recipe allows there (e.g. any planks)
gui.essentialcraft5.crafting_frame.mode..zh: 每格收配方在这个位置允许的所有东西（比如任何一种木板）

gui.essentialcraft5.crafting_frame.mode..en: Each slot only takes items identical to its sample
gui.essentialcraft5.crafting_frame.mode..zh: 每格只收和样本一模一样的东西

gui.essentialcraft5.crafting_frame.resul.en: Click with an item to find its recipe; click again for the next one; click empty-handed to clear
gui.essentialcraft5.crafting_frame.resul.zh: 拿着东西点：自动找配方、摆样本；再点换下一种做法；空手点：清空样板

tooltip.essentialcraft5.crafting_frame.s.en: Hold Shift to list the pattern
tooltip.essentialcraft5.crafting_frame.s.zh: 按住 Shift 查看样板
